snippet.title: Half-Life: HAMMERHEAD - Full Walkthrough
snippet.description:
You fall into lucid nightmare inside a physical manifestation of the last few days before deciding to take your own life. The only option now is to find a safe place while fighting and encountering manifestations of your very own hatred, fears, depression, and trauma before inevitably succumbing to your overdose.
